sections.name: Attendees
sections.asr_prompt: Meeting attendees and roles. Names, job titles, team names, departments, external guests, organiser, facilitator, note taker.
sections.synthesis_prompt: List each attendee on its own line as 'Name — role/team'. Keep the organiser first.

sections.name: Agenda
sections.asr_prompt: Meeting agenda items. Topics, planned discussion points, time allocations, presenters, priorities, follow-ups from the previous meeting.
sections.synthesis_prompt: Render as a short numbered list of agenda items, one per line.

sections.name: Discussion
sections.asr_prompt: Discussion notes. Key points raised, questions, answers, concerns, proposals, alternatives considered, context, deadlines, budgets, metrics.
sections.synthesis_prompt: Summarise the discussion as concise bullet points grouped by topic. Preserve who said what only when it matters for the outcome.

sections.name: Decisions
sections.asr_prompt: Decisions made. Decision made, agreed, approved, rejected, postponed, owner, rationale, effective date.
sections.synthesis_prompt: One bullet per decision: what was decided, who owns it, and the rationale in a single sentence.

sections.name: Action items
sections.asr_prompt: Action items and next steps. Assignee, task, due date, deadline, follow up with, blocked by, priority.
sections.synthesis_prompt: One bullet per action item in the form 'Owner: task — due date'. Flag items without an owner or date.
